CheckboxGroup.description: Provides a shared state to a series of checkboxes.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Names of the checkboxes in the group that should be initially ticked. To render a controlled checkbox group, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: value
props.description: Names of the checkboxes in the group that should be ticked. To render an uncontrolled checkbox group, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Event handler called when a checkbox in the group is ticked or unticked.
Provides the new value as an argument.

props.name: allValues
props.description: Names of all checkboxes in the group. Use this when creating a parent checkbox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox group is disabled.

additionalTypes.name: CheckboxGroup.State
